|recipe1_part1_amount = 4 |recipe1_description = {{c|gem|Level 21 Vaal Cold Snap with 20% quality}} }} '''Vaal Cold Snap''' is a [[Vaal skill|Vaal]] [[spell]] that causes an initial burst of [[Cold damage|ice]] to explode around the player, [[Freeze|freezing]] enemies. After the burst an area of [[damage over time]] releases from the player [[chill]]ing any enemy that comes into contact with it as well as awarding [[Frenzy charge]]s every second per enemy in the area. This area is considered [[chilling ground]]. ==Skill functions and interactions== The [[Damage over Time]] interacts with [[spell damage]] like most DoT skills. It also interacts with multiple sources of cold DoT. Stacking {{il|Arctic Breath}}, {{il|Cold Snap}}, {{il|Vortex}}, or any other source of Cold Damage over Time will work together. Multiple activation of the skill by other players will stack the burst but not the DoT portion of this skill. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Cold
